messages:
Anna (CSM): Heads-up — prepping an account readout for Meridian (renewal ~8w). Need exec alignment, slide deck skeleton, and enablement asks. Dry-run Wed 10am PT. Who can join? :calendar:
Mike (Support): I can do Wed 10 for the run, +1 for a short dependencies slide showing SSO & data ingestion status.
Raj (Solutions Eng): I’ll pull latest onboarding metrics and latency numbers. Will need slide with current vs expected throughput.
Emily (Exec Sponsor): I’ll join the first 20 mins for exec priorities. Can we include a one-slide asks list (pricing options + adoption milestones)?
Jamie (Customer): FYI — we want to see roadmap alignment and a concise risk/remediation section.
Anna (CSM): Great. Quick draft outline below — please react with a ✅ if you can own the slide.
```
1) TL;DR & renewal ask (owner: Anna)
2) Health snapshot: usage, adoption (owner: Raj)
3) Technical status: onboarding, SSO, ingestion (owner: Mike)
4) Risks & mitigations (owner: Anna + Raj)
5) Enablement & success plan (owner: Mike)
6) Exec asks & options (owner: Emily)
7) Appendix: logs/metrics + action tracker (owner: Anna)
```
Raj (Solutions Eng): ✅ I’ll take #2 and appendix metrics. Will attach perf graphs by Tue EOD.
Mike (Support): ✅ Taking #3 and #5. Need the list of outstanding tickets from @Anna to prioritize fixes.
Anna (CSM): Adding ticket summary now:
- TKT-4421: SSO metadata still missing from Meridian IDP (blocked)
- TKT-4478: Data ingestion retry backoff causing duplicates (in progress)
- TKT-4510: Dashboard export failing on large snapshots (low)
Mike (Support): Got it. I’ll escalate 4421 and aim for a mitigation in the dry-run notes.
EBR Bot: Reminder — create presentation in /shared/meridian/qbr/ by Tue 18:00 PT to populate slides.
Emily (Exec Sponsor): For the exec asks, proposing 2 options: 1) 12-month renewal at current price + white-glove onboarding credit; 2) 24-month with 10% discount + expanded SLA. I’ll draft language.
Anna (CSM): Proposed action items (assignments & due dates):
- Anna: create master deck template + runbook (due Tue 18:00)
- Raj: perf & adoption slides + appendix charts (due Tue 17:00)
- Mike: triage SSO ticket + mitigation note (due Wed 09:00)
- Emily: exec ask slide + positioning (due Tue 12:00)
- Jamie: confirm any internal exec attendees (due Tue 15:00)
Please update PR comments on the deck in the shared folder.
Jamie (Customer): Confirmed — two execs will attend: CTO + Head of Product. They want <10 min of top-level asks.
Anna (CSM): Noted. We’ll structure exec segment to be 8–10 minutes max.
Raj (Solutions Eng): Quick question — does the team want raw latency CSVs in appendix or just graphs?
Emily (Exec Sponsor): Graphs + 1 liner about tail latency; raw CSVs not necessary.
Mike (Support): One more ask — include a short "blocking tickets" slide with owner & ETA. Helps execs see remediation cadence.
Anna (CSM): Agree. I’ll add that as slide 4a.
EBR Bot: Dry-run scheduled: Wed 10:00–10:40 PT. Meeting link: https://zoom.company/meridian-qbr-dryrun.
Anna (CSM): Final check: reactions above. If no objections, I’ll lock the deck by Tue 18:00 PT and send calendar invites for the run. :thumbsup:
Mike (Support): LGTM.
Raj (Solutions Eng): All good from eng.
Emily (Exec Sponsor): ✅
Jamie (Customer): Thanks everyone — will get attendee confirmation and share any exec prep notes by Tue 15:00.
Anna (CSM): Thanks — assigning action tracker now and will ping individually if blockers pop up.
Mike (Support): Calling out renewal risk: adoption plateau in segment B — recommend a focused enablement webinar before exec readout. Can we add as an action?
Anna (CSM): Added: enablement webinar (owner: Mike) — schedule before dry-run if possible.
Raj (Solutions Eng): Will provide a short tech deep-dive appendix slide in case CTO asks for details.
Anna (CSM): Perfect. Closing thread for now — ping me directly for any changes.
EBR Bot: Logged meeting in EBR calendar and created action-tracker ticket: EBR-1971234988.
